title: 第22章 爷爷是仙人
novel_title: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
很快，王老那边处理好了学校的事情，并安排了离别墅区稍微近一点的学校，这学校也是王老为郁凌精挑细选的，不管是在师资力量上还是在学风上都远胜于郁凌之前所在的学校。

    这次的学校郁凡还是比上心的，毕竟事关自家孙子学业上的事，而且他孙子在学业上成绩一向都很好。

    他还是希望他能考一个更好的大学，能见识一下这个更广阔的世界。

    新的学校还有几天才会报到，郁凌也只能在家里休息了，当然他的休息就是每天沉浸在游戏中。

    被盛素华念叨了好几次后，今天盛素华强制性的将郁凌扯出他的房间。

    郁凌没有办法，只能在自家别墅里散散步以安抚他老妈那颗爱担忧的心。

    郁凌想着自己要不要去后面的游泳圈里游几圈，一个抬眸，震惊的瞪大了眼睛。

    只见他的爷爷居然从后山上漂浮而来。

    郁凌：！！！

    这世界是玄幻了吗？还是他眼花？

    他揉了揉眼睛，确定自己没有看错，他爷爷真的会飞。

    爷爷从山上凌空而下后，便浮空着朝别墅的方向而来。

    郁凌：“我的个乖乖，原来这个世界上真的有神仙吗？”

    郁凡这段时间修炼进展很快，筑基已经大圆满了，现在随时可以冲破至金丹期。

    但为了不让自己新入住的家被毁，郁凡觉得自己还是再等等，找个更为合适的地方再去渡劫。

    刚从后山下来，却看到了自家目瞪口呆的小孙子。

    郁凡立马将浮空的身体落在地面上，咳嗽了一声后，便慢慢的朝着郁凌走来。

    看着自己嘴巴都合不上的小孙子，郁凡好心的帮助他将嘴巴合上。

    “傻站在这里做什么？”郁凡一脸淡然的说道，随后便准备和郁凌擦肩而过。

    一双手紧紧的抓住了他的胳膊，声音里满是激动兴奋，“爷爷，你刚才是使用的法术吗？”

    郁凡不自在说：“胡说什么？这世界哪儿来的神仙法术？”

    “爷爷，你别想骗我，我都看到了！”郁凌的眼里像闪着星光一样，满是崇拜，“爷爷，你一定是修仙者吧？”

    郁凡被呛了一下，一时居然不知道该怎么跟这个小孩说了。

    “难怪您可以一直保持着现在的模样？”
content_en:
Soon, Mr. Wang took care of the school affairs and arranged for a school slightly closer to the villa area. This school was also carefully selected by Mr. Wang for Yu Ling. It was far superior to Yu Ling's previous school in terms of both teachers and academic style.

Yu Fan was more concerned about the school this time. After all, it was related to his grandson's academic performance, and his grandson's academic performance had always been very good.

He still hopes that he can get into a better university and see the wider world.

The new school will not register for a few days, and Yu Ling can only rest at home. Of course, his rest is to immerse himself in games every day.

After being scolded by Sheng Suhua several times, Sheng Suhua forcibly pulled Yu Ling out of his room today.

Yu Ling had no choice but to take a walk in his villa to appease his mother's worried heart.

Yu Ling was thinking about whether he should swim a few laps in the swimming pool at the back. He raised his eyes and his eyes widened in shock.

I saw his grandfather actually floating from the back mountain.

Yu Ling:!!!

Is this world a fantasy?Or is he dazzled?

He rubbed his eyes to make sure he saw it correctly. His grandfather could really fly.

After grandpa descended from the mountain, he floated towards the villa.

Yu Ling: "My dear, are there really gods in this world?"

Yu Fan's cultivation has progressed very quickly during this period, and his foundation building has been completed. He can now break through to the golden elixir stage at any time.

But in order to prevent his new home from being destroyed, Yu Fan felt that he should wait a little longer and find a more suitable place to go through the disaster.

As soon as I came down from the back mountain, I saw my little grandson who was stunned.

Yu Fan immediately dropped his floating body to the ground, coughed, and then slowly walked towards Yu Ling.

Looking at his little grandson who couldn't close his mouth, Yu Fan kindly helped him close his mouth.

"What are you doing standing here?" Yu Fan said calmly, and then he was about to pass Yu Ling.

A pair of hands grabbed his arm tightly, and his voice was full of excitement, "Grandpa, was that the spell you used just now?"

Yu Fan said uncomfortably: "What nonsense are you talking about? Where in this world does magic come from?"

"Grandpa, don't try to lie to me, I've seen it all!" Yu Ling's eyes were shining like stars, full of admiration, "Grandpa, you must be an immortal cultivator, right?"

Yu Fan choked and didn't know what to say to this child.

"Is it any wonder that you can remain the same as you are now?"
